profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I’ve spent most of my career working as an independent software developer, building custom tools and systems for clients.

I grew up on the Outer Banks of North Carolina. There were next to no opportunities for becoming a software developer or some form of an apprenticeship. Due to that I had to create my own path through freelancing, designing desktop applications for clients based on their specifications.

Those early projects gradually turned into repeat business with a range of clients. The type of projects involved data-analysis, aggregation/formatting, automation tools, and analytics platforms. The common theme has always been developing software that eliminates un-necessary difficulties through automation, or using data-analysis to identify bottlenecks and/or opportunities for improved performance.

Outside of client work I spend a lot of time exploring the engineering side of computing. Embedded systems, electronics, and signal processing are the areas that interest me most. I’m particularly interested in the boundary between software and hardware and understanding how systems behave at a low level.

Long term I’d like to move deeper into firmware development or low-level audio and signal processing work. Designing electronic circuits and working directly with hardware has become one of the most rewarding technical challenges I’ve taken on, and it’s something I continue to develop alongside my software background.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I have developed custom software solutions for over a decade, primarily for Internet Marketers and Publishers. This includes desktop software, websites, and web-scripts/tools to be deployed on servers.

My skills translate to most languages but I tend to adhere to C#, C++, PHP, Java, and Javascript.
